senses.gloss:
m. (-वः)
1 Barley, (Hordeum hexastichon.)
2 The measure of a barley corn, considered as equal to six mustard seeds.
3 A natural line across the thumb at the second joint, when it may be compared to a grain of barley, and supposed to indicate good fortune.
4 Speed, velocity.
5 A double convex lens.
E.
यु to join or mix, aff. अप्.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Relating to barley.
m. (-वः)
Lac, the red animal dye.
E.
यु to join, aff. अण्; the nest yielding a sort of resinous substance used as sealing-wax: or यव barley, to which the grains of the dye are compared, and अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
Barley.
E.
यव barley, and कन् pleonasm.

m. (-कः)
1 Half-ripe barley.
2 Awnless barley.
3 Forced rice.
4 A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus.)
5 A kind of pulse, (Dolichos biflorus.)
6 A kind of pulse said to be peculiar to Kashmir.
7 Lac.
E.
यु to mix, aff. वुन्, and अण् added, or याव as above, pleonastic aff. कन्.

mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं)
Fit for or producing barley, a field, &c.
E.
यवक barley, यत् aff.

m. (-रः)
Saltpetre, nitre, nitrate of potash.
E.
यव barley, and क्षार ashes or salt; being prepared, according to some of the commentators, accurately enough, from burnt barley, the potash being thus procured; according to others however it is so termed, from the crystals being supposed to resemble the spike of the plant.

m. (-दः)
Barley meal.
E.
यव barley, and क्षोद meal or powder.

m. (-ण्डः)
A kind of eruption on the face.
E.
यव for युव youth, and गण्ड affecting the cheek.

m. (-जः)
Nitre.
E.
यव barley, and ज born: see यवक्षार.

m. (-नः)
1 A country; probably Bactria, or it may be extended from that colony to Ionia, (to which word it bears some resemblance,) or still further to Greece: by late Hindu writers, it is most commonly applied to Arabia.
2 A Yavana, apparently originally a Greek, but since applied to both the Mohammedan and European invaders of India, and often used as a general term for any foreign or barbarous race.
3 Speed, velocity.
4 A swift horse.
f. (-नी)
The wife of a Yavana.
E.
यु to mix, aff. युच्, or जु to be swift, and the consonant changed to its analogous semivowel: or योनि the womb, (of the cow of VASIṢṬHA,) and अण् aff.; being born for the purpose of opposing the armies of VIŚVĀMITRA.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Swift, fleet.
f. (-नी)
A plant, (Ligusticum ajwaen.)
E.
यव speed, नी to possess, prefix आङ्, and aff. ड; also with कन् added, fem. form यवानिका.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Belonging or relating to a Yavana, Ionian, Mohammedan, &c.
m. (-नः)
Incense.
E.
यवन the country of the Yavanas, and अण् aff.

n. (-यं)
Black pepper.
E.
यवन a Yavana, and प्रिय fond of.

m. (-र्य्यः)
An astronomical writer, frequently quoted by Varāhamihira, and other ancient Hindu astronomers: perhaps PTOLEMY, or the Greek astronomers collectively.
E.
यवन a Yāvana, and आचार्य्य a holy teacher.

m. (-रिः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
यवन a Yavana, and अरि enemy.

m. (-लः)
1 A sort of grass, very generally cultivated, and the grain extensively eaten, (Andropogon or Holcus bicolor.)
2 Barley straw.
E.
यत्र barley, and नाल culm or stalk; also यावनाल.

m. (-लः)
A kind of grain, (Andropogon or Holcus bicolor.)
E.
यवनाल, and अण् pleonasm.

m. (-जः)
Nitre.
E.
यवनाल barley straw, and ज produced: see यवक्षार.

f. (-का)
An outer tent, a screen of cloth surrounding a tent or tents.
E.
see जवनिका, ज being changed to य.

n. (-ष्टं)
Lead.
m. (-ष्टः)
1 Garlick.
2 A sort of onion.
2 The Nimb tree.
E.
यवन a Yavana, a barbarian, and इष्ट wished, desired.

f. (-ख्या)
A small hard indolent tumor like a barley corn.
E.
यव, and प्रख्या appellation.

m. (-लः)
1 A bambu.
2 Indian spikenard.
3 A medicinal plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica)
4 An onion.
E.
यव barley, &c., and फल fruit.

n. (-ध्यं)
A form of penance, diminishing the food daily during the dark fortnight, fasting on the new moon, and gradually augmenting the food till the full moon.
f. (-ध्या)
A form of metre, a triplet, the divisions of which are of unequal length, the middle line having one syllable more than the first or last.
E.
यव barley, मध्य centrical.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made of or from barley.
E.
यव barley, and मयट् aff.

m. (-सः)
Nitre, saltpetre.
E.
यव barley, and लस to like, aff. घञ्.

m. (-कः)
Nitre, saltpetre.
E.
यव barley, and शूक the beard of corn.

m. (-कः)
Nitre, saltpetre.
E.
यव barley, शूक the spike, and अण् aff.

m. (-सः)
Meadow or pasture grass.
E.
यु to mix, असच् aff.

m. (-सः)
A flower, (Hedysarum alhagi.)
E.
यु to mix, Uṇādi aff. आस; also with कन् added, यवासक.

m. (-सः)
A quantity or heap of grass.
E.
यु to mix, Uṇādi aff. असच् with the effect of णित्, which makes the vowel long.

n. (-रं)
Spirituous or fermented liquor distilled from barley, beer.
E.
यव barley, सुरा wine, ष aff., in the neuter gender; also यवसुरा the second member being unchanged.

f. (-गूः)
Sour gruel, prepared by the spontaneous fermentation of water in which rice has been boiled.
E.
यु to mix, आगूच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-जः)
Saltpetre.
E.
यत्र barley, अग्र the top or ear, and ज born.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Youngest, very young.
m. (-ष्ठ)
A younger brother.
E.
युवन् young, इष्ठन् aff. of the irr. superlative; also with कन् added, यविष्ठक.

adv.
Like a youth.
E.
यविष्ठ, and वति aff.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Youngest, very young.
m. (-यः)
A younger brother.
E.
युवन् young, इयसुन् aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
Fit for barley, sown with barley, &c.
m. (-व्यः)
A month.
E.
यव barley, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be mixed or joined, miscible.
E.
यु to join or mix, aff. ण्यत्.

adv. (-क्यं)
To the utmost of one's power.
E.
यावत्, and शक्य able.

n. adv. (-वं)
For life, as long as life.
E.
यावत् until, जीव life.

mfn. (-यावान्, यावती यावत्)
As much, how much, such.
ind.
1 As much as.
2 As many as.
3 As long as.
4 As far as, unto, until; the correlative of तावत्.
5 When, (i. e. as much, applied to time.)
E.
यत् what or which, डवतुप् aff., and आ substituted for the pronominal final.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
That which is as far as, or as much as, &c. the ordinal of the particle यावत्.
E.
यावत् as much as, &c., and तिथक aff.

ind.
1 As much as, quantum-tantum.
2 (In algebra,) The relation of the unknown number and its co-efficient.
E.
यावत्, and तावत् so much.
